newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 8.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 8.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning.
Shares in the nation's second largest insurer list on the Australian and New Zealand stock exchanges at 0130 GMT (11.30 a.m.). Institutions paid A$1.60 per share for their reduced allocations.

The bank, one of Australia's four largest, holds its annual meeting in Melbourne with shareholders and fund managers keen to hear its forecast for the current year and the impact of the mortgage rate war on its margins.
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$16.75 (+0.31)

The company, majority partner in the highly prospective Lac de Gras diamond project in northern Canada, said official approval to proceed with the Artic mine had been delayed. It said it hoped the delay would be very short.
Major shareholder Clyde Petroleum plans to accept the 78 cent per share bid by Marsford, which has an offer three cents higher than Centennial Coal Co Ltd.
Shares in the whitegoods manufacturer have been a recent star performer, with the company unable to explain the surge and its only recent announcements being a plan to expand further into Asia.

The Australian Securities Commission continues its probe into unusual TNT options trading before the A$2.45 per share cash bid by Dutch PTT was announced last Wednesday. The ASC will present further evidence to the Federal Court in Sydney on Thursday.
